issue_request: FHIR-39085 was Published/Persuasive for R5 as a non-substantive correction asking that a Bundle Note to Balloters sentence referring to Bundle.search.code be corrected to the search entry mode code.
initial_application: No repository commit explicitly mentioned FHIR-39085. The bad ballot-note sentence was introduced in f2964b1a19; commit c1dda1d5fd corrected it to Bundle.entry.search.mode = outcome and added the matching deprecated-status reason to source/bundle/codesystem-search-entry-mode.xml.
additional_context: Bundle is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/bundle is in build scope. The target ballot note was later commented out and then removed from source/bundle/bundle-introduction.xml by 02f79b0a3b. FHIR-I minutes record the FHIR-39085 Persuasive 9-0-0 vote, and community searches did not reveal a conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current source no longer contains Bundle.search.code or the ballot note, and the remaining authoritative terminology source already says to use Bundle.issues.
